name: World orchestra
summary: Compare the world's instruments: click a region and it plays the same notes as every other region, on its own recorded instrument.
author: moran
description: The world's musical regions on one map, each with a recorded instrument (djembe, kora, oud, balalaika, khomus, morin khuur, sitar, koto, pan flute...). Click or tap a region, or use the arrow keys and Enter, to play it. Pitch, Melody and Scale are the same for every region, so only the instrument changes.
